hypothesis: Using Parquet data page version 2 for five equal 45,000,000-row DELTA_BINARY_PACKED pages with the validated windowLog-19 Zstandard settings may reduce the gate-assembled page framing while preserving the same independently compressed timestamp streams.
tested_scope: C candidate, exactly five equal 45,000,000-row pages over all 225,000,000 values; standard DELTA_BINARY_PACKED with 128-value blocks; Parquet data page version 2; Zstandard level 10, windowLog 19, hashLog 23, chainLog 25, searchLog 7, minMatch 6, targetLength 128, strategy 7, content-size flag disabled, target compressed block size 131072. A 32,000,000-row eight-page proxy emitted 65,787,610 bundle bytes; the complete candidate emitted 505,100,253 bundle bytes.
notes: The candidate changes the physical page version and equal reset cadence; schema, footer, metadata, and wrapper fields remain gate-controlled.
